title: Preserve independent capo values on multiple staves
scope: Support non-default capo values per staff and define compatibility with Track.CapoFret.
acceptance: A two-staff fixture with capos 2 and 5 retains both values and resulting pitches.
Document precedence for legacy track edits versus direct staff edits, with one source of authority.
Validate boundaries and preserve both capos through GP8 and AlphaTab without silently selecting one.

reproduction.instructions: A two-staff fixture with capos 2 and 5 retains both values and resulting pitches.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Exact model, reconciliation, boundary, GP8 wire, round-trip, sounding-pitch, and pinned AlphaTab evidence.
Checked independent staff capos 2/5 and consumer pitches 69/57, legacy-track versus staff edit authority, first-staff compatibility, and numeric boundary rejection.
commands: prek run --all-files: PASS on clean audited commit
ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 focused existing acceptance tests: PASS

resolution: Staff.CapoFret now owns each staff's non-negative capo value. GPIF import and GP8 export preserve distinct staff capos, sounding pitches, zero, and the int32 maximum; negative values are rejected before output. Track.CapoFret remains a first-staff compatibility scalar: an edit that changes its parsed value applies uniformly and wins a simultaneous staff edit, while unchanged parsed scalars leave direct staff edits authoritative. Programmatic nonzero staff values are authoritative; a legacy scalar applies uniformly only when all staff capos are zero.
